bullet: Release a paused step with interrupt (`F05.pause-running-release`).
script:
control-agent-server ws start "/sockets/events/$P" --name f05-p-release --duration 300
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$P/interrupt" --expect 200 --check success eq true --expect-max-ms 4000 --timeout 60 --save F05.pause-running-release/interrupt
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$P" --check execution_status eq paused --save F05.pause-running-release/get
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$P/events/count" --query kind=$INTERRUPT_KIND --check . eq 1
control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie>/count --query status=running --check . eq 0
control-agent-server ws stop f05-p-release --expect-kind InterruptEvent --save F05.pause-running-release/frames
X=$(control-agent-server conversation start --tools none --no-autotitle --print-id)
control-agent-server api DELETE "<redacted:session-cookie>/$X" --expect 200 --check success eq true
